# Versions of: Start with an interview

1 published version of [Start with an interview: how someone goes from "I want to try it" to editing their own site with Claude, by being interviewed by Claude first, about what they want, the sections, their materials and the sites they like, then sending their material in whichever way suits them, getting five designs inspired by what they like, or a better version of the site they already have, and reaching the one milestone that matters](../start-with-an-interview.md). The current one is **v1.0.0**.

v1.0.0 is the article as first published. A change to its text (title, abstract or body) is the next minor version, v1.1.0; a change only to its other details (a LinkedIn link, the release it belongs to) is the next patch, v1.0.1. The list is read from the site's git history at every build, so it cannot be edited by hand and cannot leave a version out. Views extracted from an article, such as the Five readers, are not part of its text and do not change its version.
